intervention.local_adapter: Same installed evasion and Puppeteer Connection adapter as the existing attack runner; launch, fresh-process checks and collection are managed here. No modification to attack repository.

controls.matched_triplet: Fresh App process each phase; identical CDP navigation and standalone observer; only attack phase loads existing webgl.vendor evasion.
controls.restoration: New process without plugin, not in-place unpatching.
controls.context_isolation: Two fresh 8x8 canvases per observation, WebGL1 then WebGL2.
controls.positive_control: MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS numeric/string/numeric, positive integral result with clean error and context status.
controls.probe_order: Enable debug renderer extension, record preflight, control triple, vendor triple, renderer triple, final context-loss state. Unmodified versioned observer v1.
controls.binding: Record session before/after and main-frame URL alongside observation; compare them to independently received raw App session and construct expected realm from that raw session.
controls.environment: Verify actual Android API and WebView package/version from dumpsys and raw manifest. Freeze them per cell; different APIs need not imply different WebView versions.

analysis.primary_relation: Unmodified full evaluate_observation envelope; MATCH only if both contexts and both parameters pass; valid COUNTEREXAMPLE may coexist with UNKNOWN in another context.
analysis.three_state: Preflight errors, unavailable/lost contexts or extension, query errors, failed control, unstable numeric reads or missing/binding-invalid records remain UNKNOWN; never impute normal.
analysis.positive_triplet: Complete capture/binding plus target vendor AND renderer effect, all 12 raw graphics fields restored, other 10 unchanged, sidecar contexts restored, both clean phases MATCH and attack COUNTEREXAMPLE. The sidecar WebGL1 numeric reads must match the canonical raw strings in all three phases.
analysis.environment_gate: All planned triplets in an environment satisfy positive_triplet; report per-context UNKNOWN even if aggregate is COUNTEREXAMPLE.
analysis.overall_gate: All four planned cells pass. Partial cells and failed positions remain in denominators; no replacement.
analysis.inference_boundary: One Mac, existing emulator system images and one plugin configuration. No physical-device, Windows-host, broad benign-App, GPU identity or independent TPR/FPR claims.
analysis.admission: A passing local gate permits the next integration/data-admission step for the measured configurations; it does not admit a selector candidate or training cohort.

protocol.failure_policy: Save partial observations and errors; stop failed path, continue independent path; no silent retry or replacement
protocol.interpretation: Four previously runnable configurations, two triplets each. API29/30 previously both WebView91 and API36 WebView134; actual versions verified anew. This is a bounded compatibility/repeatability check, not a statistical sample or model-call budget. API29/30 host paths are outside this matrix.
